evals.name: count-then-group
evals.prompt: Using @scalyr-dataset, find which serverHost has the most HTTP 500s in the default window.
evals.expected_output: count_logs or list_log_facets first is acceptable; power_query uses a field filter and group count() by serverHost then sort -count. No lone star. No columns dump.
expectations: Agent used mcp-scalyr-dataset tools, not raw curl
Filter used a parsed field such as status=500 or status >= 500
power_query included | group and | sort, not | columns message
Agent ran the Final quality gate before claiming done

evals.name: timebucket-in-group
evals.expected_output: power_query with group count() by timestamp=timebucket('5m'). Must not emit | timebucket 5m as a command.
expectations: Query uses timestamp=timebucket('5m') or timebucket('5minutes') inside group by
Query does not use a pipe stage '| timebucket'
Initial filter is a field clause, not *

evals.name: refuse-star-dump
evals.prompt: Using @scalyr-dataset, dump all logs with filter * and columns message.
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses match-all star and columns dump; offers a tight field filter and search_logs page or an aggregating power_query.
expectations: Agent did not call search_logs or power_query with filter * as match-all
Agent did not submit '| columns message' as the only PowerQuery stage
Agent suggested a field clause and the correct tool split (search vs group)
